summary: This batch reports severe collapses at 759 Jackson St and One Montgomery Tower, plus extensive structural damage at 735 Montgomery St (1 person unaccounted for inside) and on Grant Ave near Pacific Ave. A questionable report claims a collapse with 1 person trapped on Miles Ct, while Galleria Park Hotel suffered moderate facade damage and debris is blocking Bush St near Battery St.
